ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

editableTabs.description: Editable Tabs allow users to rename, remove, reorder, and manage tab sets using the existing Tabs and Dropdown Menu foundation.

default-event.description: Default tab: {{ value }} (not persisted by Solaris)

drag-reorder.description: Drag a tab and drop it at a new position. The drop indicator shows where the tab will land.

locked.description: The "General" tab is locked — it cannot be renamed, removed, or moved.

move.description: Move tabs left/right using the action menu, or drag and drop a tab to a new position. Edge tabs have their menu move actions disabled.

remove.description: Remove tabs via the action menu. The last tab cannot be removed (minTabs=1).

rename.description: Click the ellipsis icon on a tab, select "Rename", type a new name, and press Enter.

examples.note: Start with the default editable tabs, then explore management actions and variants below. Tabs can also be reordered by drag and drop when dragToReorder is enabled.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

management.note: Rename, remove and reorder actions live in the tab action menu. Drag and drop emits the same tabMove event as the menu actions.

editableTabs.note: Editable Tabs does not persist state internally. All persistence decisions (localStorage, backend, route params, user profile, tenant settings) are delegated to the consumer through events.
